FAQ

Before you start

Does the coach know if their player slept well?

Yes: the player answers two morning questions and logs water, and you see their readiness score and decide whether to lighten the workout.

Do players pay?

No. Coaches subscribe. Players join free through an invite.

Does it work offline?

Yes. Workouts and meals are saved on the phone and sync when you're back online.

Do I need the app store?

No. Open it in your browser and add it to your Android or iPhone home screen.

Can other coaches see my players?

No. Each coach can only access their own players. The database enforces this.

What if a subscription ends or I need more players?

Nothing is deleted. Players keep access for 3 days after expiry, and their history stays saved. Upgrade your plan to add more players.
